topic: Yang–Chu–Zhang (2015), Conjecture 1(ii), p. 15, and the coefficient question in Problem 1, p. 16
title: An alternative proof extending Kang's refutation of Yang–Chu–Zhang (2015), Conjecture 1(ii), p. 15

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We give an alternative proof extending Kang's (2026) refutation of Yang–Chu–Zhang (2015), Conjecture 1(ii), p. 15. For its digamma remainder family G_a, we prove G_a''(1/64)>0 for every a>=331467377585/629168992256, and G_a''(1/64)>1 for every a>=5269/10000. These bounds exclude complete monotonicity of -G_a on a parameter half-line containing strictly interior points of the conjectured range. We also give a necessary positive constant-coefficient condition in the authors' Problem 1 and characterize all its degree-four solutions as positive multiples of the function in their Theorem 4 at its endpoint.
summary: An alternative derivative proof extends Kang's known refutation: -G_a cannot be completely monotone for a>=331467377585/629168992256. Problem 1 is answered for n=1 by asymptotic cancellation and the source's Theorem 4: exactly t G_(11165/8284), t>0, with x^-6 coefficient 627404761t/10287535104. Every degree requires a_0>0. Conjecture 1(i), the n>=2 classification and the exact admissible range below the exclusion bound are not covered. The linked Lean result negates the source equivalence and supports the earlier a>=155/294-1/10000 half-unit bound; the extension and coefficient consequences have written proofs.
